title: Test signed magnetic bank realization
inputs: Accepted Phase18 signed K=N Gaussian-sector expansion
model: Odd N>=3, characteristic not dividing N, supplied primitive Nth root, four signed pairs (S^epsilon,T^delta), arbitrary phase weights, legal Delta=1-alpha^N-beta^N, finite sums of parameter-pair averaged banks; no arbitrary endpoints or products.
new_scoped_results: All four orientations are necessary and sufficient for support coverage, but coverage is not coefficient realization.
A Fourier realization requires r_plus,r_minus>=ceil((N-1)/4), hence total>=max(4,2ceil((N-1)/4)).
At N=9, each side requires at least three banks, hence total>=6.
One bank per orientation cannot realize Fourier for any odd N>=9.
Exactly four legal banks suffice and are necessary at N=3 over every admissible field.
At most 4N banks represent every matrix by explicit legal root-Vandermonde interpolation. Thus Fourier bank-count order is Theta(N), with no improved runtime consequence.

bounded_controls.N5: Complete F11 four-bank control fails; complex full coefficient realizability with one bank per orientation remains unresolved.
bounded_controls.N7: Exact Q(zeta7) necessary-row Groebner control gives the unit ideal; independently reproduced, but no all-characteristic promotion. F29 row control also fails.

actual_next_decisive_obligation: At N=9 test full legal Fourier coefficient realization with at least three parameter-pair banks on each delta side and all four orientations. Either produce exact parameters and weights verified against original inverses or an exact obstruction for that enlarged grammar. Six banks are only necessary. General growing-bank existence is settled by a coarse 4N construction. The main algorithmic obligation is compact Fourier weights and a fully charged shared evaluator; the exhibited dense interpolation has O(N^3) preparation/application and O(N^2) stored data.
relationship_to_F014: F014 counts literal two-resolvent products in one fixed Weyl coordinate pair. This counts weighted magnetic banks, each expressed by N internal phase-indexed inverses, across four signed pairs. The reused rank mechanism is classical; the row isolation and whole-bank degree-one coefficient gate are the new scoped derivation.
not_claimed: Runtime lower bound from bank count
Sufficiency at the bank-count lower bound
review_status: Accepted within stated scope by independent supplement_v5 review; exact receipt and review ledger copied into final_v1/independent_review. N7 remains an exact computational characteristic-zero result.
